result.summary: Found 1 visual layout issue where a restaurant title is unexpectedly clipped mid-character.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Tokumaru Ramen' in the 'Popular right now' section is clipped horizontally on the right, cutting off the letter 'n' ('Tokumaru Rameı') despite having ample empty space before the rating display.
issues.suggestion: Allow the title container to expand into the available flex space or use proper text ellipsis (`text-overflow: ellipsis`) only when space is genuinely constrained.
